paite: "Milimte na kibawl ding uh ahi kei. Milim bawltawm suangphuh na dingsak ding uh ahi kei. Biak ding in na gam uah suang milim na phut ding uh ahi sam kei; kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi ngal a.
heading: Thuman Ziak A Vualzawlnate / (Diu 7.12-24; 28.1-14)
english: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am Yahweh your God.

paite: Ka Sabbathte na tang ding ua, ka mun siangthou na zahtak ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Ka thusehte na man ua, ka thupiakte pom a na man uleh ahunhun in vuahtui ka hon zusak ding hi.
english: “‘If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments, and do them,

paite: Lei in thil ahon piangsak dia, gam a singte'n gah asuang ding uhi.
english: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

paite: Na phual ua buh in grep loh hun abanpha dia, na grep loh hun un thil chin hun abanpha ding hi. Na tanghou uh niang-le-tai in na ne ding ua, na gam uah bittak in na teng ding uh.
english: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

paite: "Hiai gam ah muanna ka omsak dia, na lum ding ua, kuamah in ahon lausak kei ding. Gamsa hoihloute hiai gam a pan ka hawlmang dia, namsau in na gam uh atuansuak sam kei ding hi.
english: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

paite: Na melmate uh na delh ding ua, na ma uah namsau a thah in a-om ding uh.
english: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

paite: Mi nga in zakhat na delh ding ua, zakhat in singkhat na delh ding uh. Na melmate uh na ma uah namsau a thah in a-om ding uhi.
english: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

paite: K'on deihsak dia, chi tampi ka hon suangsak ding hi. Na lak uah ka thukhun ka hihkip ding.
english: “‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.

paite: Sawtpi na kepsa, aluite na ne ding ua, athak koihna ding in aluite na lakhe ding uh.
english: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.

paite: Na lak uah ka biakbuk ka omsak dia; ka hinna in noute ahon kih kei ding.
english: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.

paite: Na lak uah ka teng dia, na Pathian uh ka hi dia, nou leng ka mite na hi ding uh.
english: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.

paite: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh, asikha uh na hihlouhna ding ua Aigupta gam a pan noute hon pikhepa ka hi. Na hakkolte uh ka hihtanta a, dingtang in ka hon paisakta hi.
english: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you walk upright.

paite: "Himahleh ka thu pom lou a, hiai thupiak tengteng na zuih kei ua, ka thusehte na deih kei ua,
heading: Thuman Louh Ziak A Gawtna / (Diu 28.15-68)
english: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments,

paite: na hinna un ka vaihawmte ahuat a, ka thupiak tengteng zui lou a, ka thukhun na bohsiat uleh ke'n leng na tung uah hiai ka hih ding.
english: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,

paite: Na tung uah thil lauhuai, na hinna uh netum leh na mit uh hihsia kumzawnna leh khodam ka lengsak ding hi. Na haichite uh bangmah lou dia ching na hi ding ua, na melmate un ane zel ding uh.
english: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.

paite: Na tung uah ka mai ka gumsak dia, na melmate uh ma ah na vuallel ding uh. Nou hon hote'n na tung uah vai ahawm ding ua, kuamah delh louh in na tai ding uhi.
english: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.

paite: "Huchi pipi a leng ka thu na pom kei lai uleh na khelhnate uh ziak in sagihvei ka hon gawt lai ding hi.
english: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.

paite: Na thilhihtheihna ki-otsakna uh ka hihse dia, na tung ua van sik bang in leh na nuai ua lei sumsan bang in ka bawl ding.
english: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like bronze.

paite: Na tha uh na sengthawn lel ding ua; na gam un thil apiangsak kei dia, gam a singte'n gah asuang sam kei ding uh.
english: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.

paite: "Kei kalh lam a na om ua, ka thu na pom kei uleh na khelhna uh dungzui in amun sagih in na tung uah gawtna ka tungsak ding.
english: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.

paite: Na lak uah gamsate ka hon sawl dia, huaite'n na tate uh ahon laksak ding ua, na gantate uh ahihmangthang ding ua, na hong tawm mahmah ding ua, na lampite uh nutsiat in a-om ding hi.
english: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become desolate.

paite: "Hiaite tawn a ka hon bawlhoihna na pom tuan kei ua, kei kalh a na om lailai uleh,
english: “‘If by these things you won’t be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me,

paite: ke'n leng nou ka hon kalh dia, kei mahmah in na khelhnate uh ziak in sagihvei ka hon gawt ding hi.
english: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.

paite: Huchi in na tung uah namsau ka lengsak dia, huai in ka thukhun na palsat uh phu ala ding hi. Noumau khosung chiat a na kibawmkhawm chiang un, na lak uah hii ka lengsak dia, melma khut a piak na hi ding uh.
english: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

paite: Na muanpen uh tanghou ka beisak chiang in, numei sawm in thuk khat ah na tanghou uh a-emkhawm ding ua, na tanghou uh buk chitchiat in ahon pe ding ua; na ne ding ua, na kham tuan kei ding uh.
english: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.

paite: "Huchi tengteng a leng ka thu na pom kei ua, kei kalh a na om lailai uleh hehtak in noute ka hon kalh ding hi.
english: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me,

paite: Na khelhnate uh ziak in sagihvei, kei mahmah in ka hon gawt ding hi.
english: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.

paite: Na tapate uh sa na ne ding ua, na tanute uh sa na ne nalai ding uhi.
english: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.

paite: Na mun sangte uh ka chimsak dia, na milimte uh ka puksak dia, na luang uh na milimte uh luang tung ah ka pai ding. Ka hinna in nou ahon kih ding hi.
english: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.

paite: Na khuate uh ka gamsak dia, na mun siangthoute uh ka hawmsak dia, na gimlimte uh ka dik kei ding hi.
english: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.

paite: Gam ka hihse ding a; huai a om na melmate un lamdang asa ding uh.
english: I will bring the land into desolation, and your enemies who dwell in it will be astonished at it.

paite: Namdangte lak ah ka hon dalhsak dia, noute hon delhzui ding in namsau ka phawi ding. Huchi in na gam uh ahawm dia, na khuate uh agam ding.
english: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.

paite: Ahawm sung teng leh na melmate uh gam a na om sung teng uh gam in a Sabbathte atang dia, a Sabbathte ah nuam asa ding uhi.
english: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.

paite: Ahawm sung teng in akhawl ding; asung a na ten lai ua, na Sabbath nite ua, akhawl louh ziak un.
english: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths when you lived on it.

paite: "Na lak ua mi omsunte, amelmate uh gam ah alungtang sung uah bahna ka omsak ding hi. Nahthel ging in leng adelh dia, namsau a pan taikek bang in ataikek ding ua, kuamah delh louh in apuk ding uh.
english: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.

paite: Kuamah delh louh in namsau ma a taikek bang in akipalpuk lemlum ding ua; na melmate uh dal ding in hatna himhim na nei kei ding uh.
english: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.

paite: Namdangte lak ah na mangthang ding ua, na melmate gam in noute ahon negai ding.
english: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.

paite: Na lak ua omsunte na melmate uh gam ah athulimlouhna ziak un, amuih hiaihiai ding ua; api-le-pute un athulimlouhnate uh ziak a amuihloh bang un amau leng amuihloh sam ding uhi.
english: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.

paite: Ka tung a akhelh ziak leh athulimlouhna uh leh api-le-pute thulimlouhna leh kei kalh a a-om ziak un,
english: “‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me; and also that because they walked contrary to me,

paite: ke'n leng amau ka kalh a, amelmate uh gam a ka omsakdante akitheihmohbawl kei ding ua; asum louh lungtang ua akiniamkhiak ua, athulimlouhna uh ziak a ka gawtna apom uleh, Jakob kiang a ka thukhun ka theigige ding hi.
english: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity,

paite: Isak leh Abraham kiang a ka thukhunte ka theigige ding hi.
english: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.

paite: "Agam mah leng ka theigige ding hi. Gam in leng akihepmangsan dia, amau om lou in ahawm sung in a Sabbathte ah nuam asa ding. Ka vaihawmte adeih louh ziak uh leh ahinna un ka dan thusehte amuh nop louh nak ziak in, athulimlouhna uh gawtna apom ding uhi.
english: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.

paite: Huchi pipi in leng, amelmate uh gam a a-om un amaute ka paimang kei dia, amaute hihmangthang ding leh ka thukhun bohse ding in amaute ka kih kei ding; kei TOUPA a Pathian uh lah ka hi ngal a.
english: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them; for I am Yahweh their God.

paite: A Pathian uh ka hihtheihna dia namte mitmuh a Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak, apipute uh thukhun amaute ziak in ka theigige zaw ding hi. Kei TOUPA ka hi, chi in," achi hi.
english: But I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am Yahweh.’”

paite: Hiaite Sinai Tang a Mosi zang a amah leh Israel suante kal a TOUPA'N abawl thupiakte, vaihawmte leh dante ahi.
english: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws, which Yahweh made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.
